item.title: Kelly Brady SSE Airtricity/Soccer Writers personality of the year
item.description: World Cup-bound Roberto ‘Pico’ Lopes of Shamrock Rovers and New York-born Kelly Brady scooped the annual SSE Airtricity/Soccer Writers Ireland Personality of the Year awards at Friday’s gala ceremony in Dublin. Lopes, captained Rovers to the SSE Airtricity Men’s Premier Division and FAI Cup double for the first time since 1987, topped the ballot of football media. item.title: Cabinet to consider age verification for social media apps
item.description: Age verification for social media apps is a step closer. A memo could be brought to Cabinet next week on tightening controls here, rather than introducing an outright ban. From Wednesday, under 16s in Australia will be banned from holding accounts on social media platforms like TikTok and Snapcat. item.title: Shane Mc Guirk suffers a defeat at the Lakeside
item.description: Shane Mc Guirk seen his reign as the WDF world darts champion come to an end on Friday night when he went down by 4 sets to 1 to the number 1 seed Jimmy Van Schie from the Netherlands. It was a first defeat for the Monaghan dart player on the iconic Lakeside stage, having made his debut at the championships last year and claimed the title with a 6-3 win over Paul Lim This year see the Arrow register wins over Petri Rasmus, Stefan Schroder and Jonas Masalin to reach the last 16. item.title: Zelenskyy visit was "very important" - Ukrainian woman living in Cavan
item.description: A Ukrainian woman living in Co Cavan described this week's state visit by Volodymyr Zelenskyy as "very important." Antonia Karelina who is from Ukraine but lives in Co Cavan said she greeted Zelensky's visit with "all her of her heart." Antonia also believes that Ireland is one of the strongest allies of Ukraine, adding that the support shown since the war broke out has been "unwavering." item.title: Cavan councillor reminding men to avail of regular health checks
item.description: A Cavan Councillor is reminding men of the importance of having regular health checks. Cllr Damien Brady has shared his experience of going through treatment for cancer. He had no symptoms, but a routine blood test showed that he was ill and it was therefore caught early. He was happy to share that his own health is getting on well at the moment. Speaking to Northern Sound, he encouraged men to get routine medical checks every year. Advertisement

item.title: Over €3 million allocated to beef farmers across region
item.description: A total of over 3 million euro has been allocated to beef farmers across the Northern Sound region. It comes under the Suckler Carbon Efficiency Programme, which aims to help farmers improve the environmental sustainability of the national beef herd. The funding will be made available to 724 farmers in Co. Cavan and 485 in Co. Monaghan. Cavan senator Joe O'Reilly says it's a good news story: Advertisement

item.title: Cuchulainns looking to continue the winning form
item.description: This Sunday will see Cuchulainns of Cavan taking on Glenullin of Derry in the Ulster Intermediate club final at 1pm in St Tiernachs Park Clones. Having claimed the county title the Cavan champions have been impressive in the provincial championship accounting for Irvinstown of Fermanagh in the quarter final and overcoming one of the favourites in Clonoe of Tyrone in the semi final.
